panes.rule0:
-- peano's first rule, rule <k> run(s(N)) => run(pred(s(N))) </k>: its left side.
-- N is variable 0, V (s(N) #as V) variable 1, the counter cell variable 2.
example : c.rules[0]?.map (·.lhs) = some
    (.app topLabel [
      .app Sym.«<k>» [.app kseq [
        .inj Srt.«State» KCore.Srt.kitem (.app Sym.«run» [.as (.app Sym.«s» [.var 0]) 1]),
        .app dotk []]],
      .var 2]) := rfl

panes.predEval:

example : Eval c Sym.«pred» [s z] (some z) := pred_succ z (by decide +kernel)

  pred_owise z (by decide +kernel) (fun M h => by injection h with h1; exact absurd h1 (by decide))
